notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.5

- Fixed a bug in chapter 8 where it was possible to access an incorrect area of the map.
- Other minor bugs fixed

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug where the count of orbs collected was wrong
- Fixed a bug in chapter 07 where the player would get stuck in a part of the map
- Fixed an error in the English text of the memories screen

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.3

- Fixed a bug where in the 1st chapter there was a "hole" in a block that allowed the player to leave the map (Thanks GDSpectra for reporting this bug on discord)
- Other minor fixes
